synth.notes:
Board = 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks parsed from frame colours (axis ring 10, targets 11, pieces ring 5, reflections ring 4, bg 9).
Selection read from 0 centres; selected piece grown from 0-centre blocks through non-9-centre blocks.
A1/A2 move axis or selected piece one block row; A3/A4 move selected piece one column (blocked by edge/other pieces; axis A3/A4 no-op); A5 cycles axis -> pieces by size desc -> axis.
Reflections: off-axis piece blocks mirror to row 2A-r, skipped off-board/onto pieces; HUD col 63 gains one 12 per effective action.
Unconfirmed: axis never blocked by pieces; A6/A7 no-ops; fully stateless.
